messages:
Maya: heads-up — Atlasica went into a big embed ramp overnight, their committed credits are burning much faster than forecast. tagging for runway + QBR input.
Owen: looking at raw windows now. noticed a spike starting ~02:15 UTC, sustained through early morning.
Maya: rough runout estimate?
Owen: current balance 120k credits. 7d avg ~10.8k/day, but last 48h avg ~21.5k/day. naive projection -> ~5 days if surge continues.
Ravi: yikes. we should propose immediate mitigations: soft throttle non-prod keys, KV prefix caching, and schedule heavy reporting to off-peak.
Jules: customer emailed — they want to keep demos for next week. sales asked if we can propose a short-term uplift + a mitigation plan for approval.
Maya: proposed QBR checklist: runout date + burn drivers, short-term mitigations, top-up ask (exact amount), enablement call notes to reduce future spikes, renewal risk flag.
Owen: quick numbers dump:
```
period, avg/day, recent/day
7d, 10.8k, 21.5k
30d, 9.2k, 18.3k
projection (if surge persists): 5 days
```
Ravi: I'll set up a 30m enablement with Atlasica infra tomorrow — focus: prefix caching, request routing, and reducing embed frequency during reports.
Maya: costbot just triggered an alert: 
costbot: ALERT account=atlasica metric=embed_burn change=+210% baseline_window=1719900000 threshold=200% -> notify cs-oncall
Jules: sales asked for an asks table. Maya, can you recommend an exact credit top-up and any conditional SLA we should offer?
Maya: recommend a 150k immediate top-up (covers ~7 days at current surge) + a 90k reserve to cover a 2-week glide if mitigations take effect. propose a temporary soft-throttle on non-prod and a one-time enablement session.
Owen: I'll add a row in the QBR deck with estimated unit economics impact (delta per-embed) and a tiny sensitivity table (if burn drops 30% after caching).
Ravi: runbook snippet I'm going to push to them:
```
- enable_kv_cache: true
- reporting_window: set 60m -> 6h for heavy reports
- nonprod_quota: 10% of prod
- prefix_routing: prioritize prod keys
```
Maya: tasking: Owen -> numbers + deck slide, Ravi -> runbook + enablement call, Jules -> coordinate with sales/account for ask sign-off, Maya -> draft top-up req & renewal note. react when you have it.
Owen: got it :thumbsup:
Ravi: on calendar :white_check_mark:
Jules: pinged account, awaiting response.
Maya: we'll include three slides in QBR: spend variance, mitigation plan & timeline, asks + impact. capture feedback from enablement to update renewal risk.
Jules: if customer pushes back on top-up, we should have an alternative: 1) temporary rate limit for demo endpoints 2) prioritized support during the surge 3) joint runbook review.
Maya: good backup options. closing notes: capture the enablement call summary and any action items as bullet points for the renewal section.
